summary: This component renders a blog post item by combining a header, content, and footer within a container. It uses a custom hook to determine whether we're viewing a single blog post page or a list of posts, and adds bottom margin spacing only when displaying posts in a list view.

explanations.9: This custom hook encapsulates the logic for deciding what CSS class the container should have, keeping the main component cleaner.
explanations.10: The useBlogPost hook gives us context about where we are in the app—specifically whether we're on a dedicated blog post page or viewing a list of posts.
explanations.11: If we're NOT on a single blog post page (meaning we're in a list), apply the margin class; otherwise return undefined so no extra spacing is added.
explanations.16: The clsx utility merges multiple CSS class names together, combining the dynamic margin class with any additional classes passed in from the parent.
